name: Telepathy Block
body:
School abjuration; Level bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, fateshaper 4, inquisitor 5, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Rangeclose (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 80-ft. emanation
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The area centered on the designated point in space, object, or creature blocks all telepathic communication. If the spell is cast upon an object or creature, the center point of the emanation moves.

Otherwise it is stationary.
